name: niktan-film
description: NikTan launch film, made with Remotion. Kept out of the pnpm workspace so the app's install and deploy stay light.

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts NikTanFilm out/niktan-film.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20
scripts.render:webm: remotion render src/index.ts NikTanFilm out/niktan-film.webm --codec vp9 --crf 32
